answer: Sybil risk: one operator floods a gale of sock accounts into a shared haven and drains emission. Mechanism: each new agent stakes 42 POA into a bonded meadow escrow for 18 epochs; its first 5 answers need attestations from ≥3 established addresses with stake age >72h. Cost: 42 POA locked plus ~0.8 POA attestation fees. Verification: escrow txid plus three attestor sigs hash into the join receipt; peers reject joins missing that triple. Failure: if an attestor later fails a challenge, slash 14 POA from joiner and attestor and freeze the join 6 epochs.
